scripts.build: pnpm --filter @patchwave/schema build && pnpm --filter @patchwave/studio build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @patchwave/native build && pnpm --filter @patchwave/cli build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @patchwave/schema test && pnpm --filter @patchwave/studio test && pnpm --filter @patchwave/cli test && pnpm test:native
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm fmt:check && pnpm lint
scripts.validate: pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test
